name: ble_bb_ch585
description: CH585 plaintext BLE register subset. No reset values or unsupported field meanings inferred. Not a CH582 register map.

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.description: Channel in bits 6:0; mode mask 0x300, idle 0x100, active 0x200. Other fields require their own evidence.

registers.name: TX_ACCESS_ADDRESS
registers.description: Access address for selected radio link.

registers.name: RX_CONFIG_10
registers.description: Observed receive setup; whole-field meanings not admitted.

registers.name: RX_CONFIG_18
registers.description: Observed LE1M receive setup; whole-field meanings not admitted.

registers.name: TX_CONTROL
registers.description: Low two bits control paused/staged TX; ordering is specified in behavior notes.

registers.name: RSSI_STATUS
registers.description: Source RSSI extraction uses negative signed byte from value >> 15; calibration not established.

registers.name: INTERRUPT_ENABLE
registers.description: Interrupt source enables; complete field semantics not admitted.

registers.name: INTERRUPT_STATUS
registers.description: W1C subset bits 4..8. Capture bit 6, CRC-error bit 5. Snapshot before clearing; capture acknowledges only bit 6 before CRC ownership is consumed.

registers.name: CONFIG_3C
registers.description: Observed CH585 initialization 0x0002020c; not a reset-value claim.
